{{Quote|Skawn's band, at the time Palpatine declared himself Emperor, went by the name Sonic Free. They rebelled against the laws restricting their performances and censoring their recordings|Skawn Bonduna's biography on the Imperial Posting DataCore|<ref name="GC6" />}}
'''Skawn Bonduna''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] celebrity and [[Musician/Legends|musician]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the later reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he performed the lead role in the [[Band/Legends|band]] [[Sonic Free]], which rebelled against new Imperial laws on [[Music/Legends|music]]. All members of the band were [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]], except for Bonduna, who gained a 30,000-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head. The Twi'lek then assumed aliases traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and earning low [[Currency/Legends|wages]] performing in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], and [[Passenger liner/Legends|cruise liners]]. At one point, Bonduna was identified aboard a luxury liner, causing word to spread about his appearance.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Two weeks ago Skawn was identified in a chance encounter aboard a luxury liner that travelled a little too close to the Mid Rim for Skawn's tastes. He denied that he was indeed Skawn Bonduna, but word leaked out. This is an old posting, but the Empire's credits are still good.|Skawn Bonduna's biography on the Imperial Posting DataCore|<ref name="GC6" />}}
During the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Skawn Bonduna was a celebrity rising in popularity. The teenager would occasionally appear in [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] and, at an early age, garnered success through popular [[Music/Legends|recordings]]. Bonduna did not shirk the pursuit of knowledge and was academically successful, enough so that his test scores indicated he could have thrived as a [[Governor/Legends|governor]] or [[Lawyer/Legends|attorney]].<ref name="GC6" /> When the Republic was reformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="GC6" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. As the members of [[Sonic Free]] are stated to be [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the Empire's reign, the latest date the imprisonment can occur is [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]].</ref> Bonduna was the lead performer in a [[Band/Legends|band]] that went by the name [[Sonic Free]],<ref name="PartI">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> in which he and the other members used harmless subliminals in their music to uplift the moods of their listeners.<ref name="PartI" /> 

[[File:Imperial_Emblem.svg|thumb|right|200px|Bondura was wanted by the Galactic Empire (emblem pictured).]]
Bonduna and Sonic Free rebelled against the new Imperial laws that had their performances restricted and their recordings censored, causing the members to be charged by the Empire. The government body claimed that Sonic Free manipulated their innocent listeners with their words, allowing them to fall to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] propaganda<ref name="GC6" /> and start revolting.<ref name="PartI" /> By [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> all members of the band, save for Bonduna, who gained an Imperial [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head, were arrested by the Empire and [[Death/Legends|died]] in a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] brawl.<ref name="GC6" /> Bonduna evaded capture and traveled across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] under aliases. In the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], the musician made low income performing in many second rate [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], and [[Passenger liner/Legends|cruise liners]].<ref name="GC6" />

At some point during the Empire's reign, Bonduna was discovered on a luxury liner that traveled too close to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] for the performer's tastes. He denied that he was himself, but word spread of his discovery. Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, the information on the incident was made available by the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]] on the [[Imperial Enforcement DataCore/Legends|Imperial Posting DataCore]] database. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], he was marked for disintegration for a reward of 30,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for anyone that held an [[Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate/Legends|Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate]].<ref name="GC6" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Unfortunately, the glamour would turn this teen heartthrob into a pompous, arrogant, whiner.|Skawn Bonduna's biography on the Imperial Posting DataCore|<ref name="GC6" />}}
Bonduna's listing on the Imperial Posting DataCore described him as a teen heartthrob whose circumstances made him a pompous and arrogant whiner. He was a pale-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of a marking on his head and an orange and black tattoo of a flaming horned head on his left<ref name="GC6" /> [[Lekku/Legends|lek]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> Bondura was a [[Smoking/Legends|smoker]].<ref name="GC6" /> His name originated from Twi'lek culture; "Skawn," a masculine first name, translated to "[[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]," and "Bonduna," a clan surname, meant "descended from [[Bondu]]," who was an ancient Twi'lek hero.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Even though he often graced the holovid and enjoyed a successful string of popular recordings at a very young age, Skawn never neglected his studies.|Skawn Bonduna's biography on the Imperial Posting DataCore|<ref name="GC6" />}}
Bonduna was a persuasive and charismatic man who could use intimidation to his advantage. Skills possessed by the Twi'lek included bluffing, making music, singing, and gathering information. An adaptive learner, he was knowledgeable about government and music. Bonduna could read, speak, and write the [[Language/Legends|languages]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]]. Additionally, he could speak the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] language and use his lekku for communication. He was proficient in using simple [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], including [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].<ref name="GC6" />

==Equipment==
Bonduna wore a red [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], a black [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] with studded shoulders, a studded [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with a chain, black pants, and black shoes with a slight platform. The Twi'lek accessorized with two [[Ring/Legends|rings]] on his right hand and red [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]]. He used a gold instrument decorated with red flames secured with a cross-body strap. Other possessions of his included a blaster pistol, a sound caster, and a tool kit.<ref name="GC6" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gamer_6.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Skawn Bonduna was first pictured in ''Star Wars Gamer'' 6.]]
Skawn Bonduna was first indirectly mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] article "Hunting Down ''Gamer'' #6," as part of ten bounties meant for use in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|''Star Wars Roleplaying Game'']] that would appear in the then-upcoming [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth issue]] of the magazine ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]''.<ref name="SW.com" /> The article was published on [[August 15]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com" /> Bonduna was then first pictured in "[[Bounties to Die For]]," an article in the sixth issue written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]], illustrated by [[Ramón Pérez]],<ref name="GC6" /> and released on [[September 4]], 2001.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010815.html|text=Hunting Down ''Gamer'' #6}}</ref>

In "[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away: Part 1]]," a [[November 21]], [[2013]] article written by [[Edward M. Erdelac]] for the official StarWars.com blog, the character was mistakenly referred to as "Skwan Bonduna." The blog post also mistakenly states the character was arrested with his band and that he escaped custody, fleeing into the Mid Rim.<ref name="PartI" />
